scope: Actual current Task overview and its existing Work navigation, with synthetic read responses. No backend persistence, permission enforcement, human usability or global layout acceptance.

approval.ref: Owner-authorized implementation continuation; root scoped the renderer delta on 2026-10-12

surfaces.description: Existing openTaskDialog mounting its real mountTaskWork, public DS and current production CSS

environment.input: native pointer; no forced click or focus/scroll repair
environment.data_profile: Deterministic synthetic Task and work read responses; original tabs-geometry read adapter reused

checks.method: native actual Task rendering and CTA navigation
checks.acceptance: Completed sessions with selected rejected or blocked steps retain exact step title, agent context and Open work CTA. The overview has no unqualified completed-session status; the full Work heading keeps its existing session status and identifies the selected step as needing revision or an answer. No write attempt.

checks.method: native actual Task rendering and CTA navigation
checks.acceptance: Review retains separate review status, full selected-step title, predefined short literal result (including angle brackets and ampersand) and review CTA. CTA opens the matching full step/result in Work; it does not approve or reject anything. Overview has no decision buttons. No write attempt.

checks.method: native actual Task rendering and CTA navigation
checks.acceptance: Open question with canAnswer=false retains Agent waiting for answer status, exact question title and neutral secondary Open question CTA. It takes precedence over a pending review; CTA opens the matching question without offering confirmation or enabling answer fields. No write attempt.

checks.method: native actual Task rendering and CTA navigation
checks.acceptance: Completed session with approved done step and no outstanding question/review/problem step retains Work completed as its main overview text and Open work CTA, without an extra status row. No write attempt.

Capture current long-review Task at desktop and 390 before any navigation: full viewport PNG plus raw summary/title/CTA/preview, first four properties, disclosure box and its text rectangles, description and scrollport geometry. No geometry PASS, perfect-fit threshold or Compact adoption verdict.

checks.method: exact package and compiled source fingerprints
checks.acceptance: Actual Git revision/tree, frozen plan hash, source and complete module-input hashes, compiled-output hashes and installed DS byte equality are recorded. Native uses a clean committed checkout and compiled preview with real production modules.

not_run: Backend writes, grants enforcement and agent execution
Compact redesign, result truncation change or perfect first-screen fit
Estimate interaction or integration with PR83
Create/type/template, disclosure changes, accepted Task result and other unrelated flows
Real Safari, Firefox, iOS touch and screen readers: separate pre-release verification
